summary: Capitalist-simulator game: become a business manager, build a perfect simulation
description:
Build & manage your own factory in a wonderful idle game. Factory: Idle & Tycoon Game is the idle tycoon simulator and business game. Build your own factory and improve your business skills with our perfect tycoon simulation. Factory: Idle & Tycoon Game is a great combination of business games and idle games. Train logic and creativity and become the business tycoon!
 
Invest in factory simulation and become the richest capitalist. Factory: Idle & Tycoon Game welcomes you to the idle simulation world of fake industry. Grow your underground counterfeit factory, build and upgrade product assembly lines, install automation robots, and manage warehouse in this unique idle rpg game. More cash, workers and products enable you to grow and upgrade your factory busines. Become a factory tycoon capitalist, build and manage the world's most prosperious factory.
  
Our features:
- Our tycoon idle game is Free to play.
- Simple but challenging gameplay will keep you excited all the time! Find the ways to build and upgrade your factory to become an idle billionaire tycoon.
- Play without internet connection. Our clicker game is available for you anywhere any time!
- Use your idle cash to boost your income and improve the factory.
- Invest more to gain more! Train your investing sense with Factory: Idle & Tycoon business game.
- Explore premium features and solve levels to build up your business empire.

Don't miss the chance to become a billionaire tycoon, build up your factory and collect idle cash in our business simulator. Share your thoughts and suggestions with us to make the game better. Become the richest factory tycoon ever! 
Explore Factory: Idle & Tycoon Game - the idle tycoon simulator and business game. Build a factory and become the business tycoon!
